{{Quote|Yeah, well, when the citizens of Rampa 1 heard about what was going on, they rose up, too. For all the good it's gonna do 'em.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="THG" />}}
In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the inhabitants of [[Rampa 1]] staged an '''uprising''' against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in response to the massacres that occurred during the [[Rampa 2]] [[Rampa 2 uprising|uprising]].<ref name="THG" /> The Imperial retaliation led to another massacre.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
